_comment: Per-contract WASM size budgets for the release build (#956). Budget = measured size + 5% headroom. The token budget reflects lock_tokens, withdraw_locked (#1076, #1077), and role proposals (#914, #918, #1308); vesting links the token crate, so that same code is included in its WASM. The rate-limit and split budgets are raised by #914/#918 as well: both contracts link the bc-forge-admin crate, whose privileged-action timelock, role renounce, and proposal listing additions compile into their WASMs.
_measured_on: cargo 1.96.0, wasm32-unknown-unknown, --release, zero warnings. #914/#918 re-measured on 1.94.0; rate-limit/split re-measured on 1.96.0; token/vesting re-measured on 1.96.0 (#1308); rate-limit/token/vesting re-measured on 1.96.0 (#1329/#1330).
